sam: ping — Tidepool sent LoRA v1.2. Merged to `cust/tidepool/lora-v1.2` but QA sees token aliasing: bullets convert to letters (a., b.) on some prompts. Blocking.

leena: can you paste a minimal repro?

sam: ```
Prompt: "Give the steps to enable sync."
Gold: "1) Open app\n2) Tap sync\n3) Confirm"
Merged: "a) Open app\nb) Tap sync\nc) Confirm"
```

marcos: odd
83d
c40  '1) -> a)' implies special-token id remap or vocab permutation. Check `lora_meta.tokenizer` and special token order.

sam: meta shows `\"tokenizer\": \"sentencepiece\"` and specials in a different order. We also noticed sparse vocab entries in their mapping which caused aliasing for numeric/glyph tokens.

leena: try `tools/token_alias_fix.py`  it handles remapping numeric glyph tokens and special order. Example: `python tools/token_alias_fix.py --map numeric_map.json --in artifacts/tidepool/lora.pt --out artifacts/tidepool/lora-remapped.pt`

sam: ran remap + remerge. token_alias_ratio dropped from 0.014 -> 0.002. Much better. But now seeing KV-cache mismatch on long-context prompts that shifts enumeration mid-stream.

marcos: KV-cache mismatch? could be kv-projection dim differences. Did merge logs warn about kv proj sizes?

sam: merge log had WARN: `kv_proj_dims differ: src=1280 dst=1024 -- applying projection pad/truncate`. That truncation can misalign attention when context crosses cache boundaries. I re-ran `scripts/align_kv_proj.py --pad-to 1280` and produced a re-merged artifact.

ci-bot: quick-eval started job=99222 logs=https://ci.redwood/jobs/99222/logs

leena: eval run (180 prompts) command used:
```
./bin/run_quick_eval \
  --model artifacts/tidepool/merged-remapped \
  --prompts evals/tidepool_smoke_180.json \
  --quant fp16,int8,int4 \
  --out /tmp/tidepool_eval.json
```

sam: results (prelim): fp16 acc=0.68, int8=0.67, int4=0.61. Token-alias regressions mostly resolved; remaining diffs cluster on long-context enumerations when context length >2048 (KV window edge).

marcos: proposed plan:
1) require numeric-token-alias remap when `metadata.tokenizer != model.tokenizer` OR when `vocab_sparsity > 0.01` in LoRA metadata;
2) enforce KV-proj-dim compatibility as a pre-merge check and fail merges where projection would require truncation (high-risk);
3) default new customer LoRA artifacts to int8 in Dedicated/Private until we validate int4 kernels for that artifact;
4) add a long-context enumeration smoke test (extend smoke pack with >2048 context cases).

leena: i'll open a PR adding `check_numeric_alias.py`, `check_kv_proj_compat.py` and wiring them into the onboarding pipeline. Also update docs and the SE checklist to request original tokenizer model and kv-proj config from the customer.

sam: add CI gate rules: fail if `token_alias_ratio > 0.5%` or `kv_proj_mismatch == true`. If ratio between 0.2%-0.5% open triage task and notify Eng/SE.

docs-bot: Created onboarding doc stub at docs/onboarding/customer_lora.md#tidepool-guidance

sam: thanks 44d i'll re-run the full eval after the PR merges and post artifacts here. ETA tomorrow morning PST.
